Results.ReviewText:
My spouse and I needed to buy a BBQ for our family (we have two small children) and there are so many to choose from it can be overwhelming! But using all the internet reviews as our guide, we settled on the renowned Weber name to guide us. We decided to go with a smaller BBQ as opposed to larger, and this Spirit II is suiting us just fine. We have plenty of room to cook enough to feed the family and have some leftovers for lunches. If we have a larger party over at some point we will likely need to cook in batches, but we don't host much so I think we'll be good.

Oh my gosh, the unmistakable BBQ flavour on our hamburgers, steaks, chicken breasts and chicken thighs is unbeatable! I haven't gone much outside the box yet (cooking pizzas or veggies, for example), but I'm interested in mixing it up at some point. 

One thing I've noticed is that I can't get it to heat up past 500 degrees - not sure if this is a flaw or just part of the design specs. The thermometer reads up to 600 degrees, so I assumed it would go that high. Either way, 500 degrees seems to be hot enough to cook things so far.

The only downside I can see to the BBQ (to any BBQ, for that matter) will be when it comes time to deep clean it. I had to laugh out loud at myself, because the first thing I cooked on it was a bunch of fatty hamburgers. When I saw how dirty it became after the first cook I was so disappointed! I wanted it to stay nice and shiny, which I know is unrealistic. So I'll get out the soapy water and scrub brush at the end of the BBQ season to give it a good once over before it goes into storage for the winter. Which reminds me - I'm so sad to think there will be months on end when I won't be using this amazing tool! Maybe I can figure out how to BBQ in the snow...
Results.Title: Best (only) BBQ I've ever owned!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
